name: Promptfoo
summary: Config-driven prompt and model testing that runs in CI, including safety and jailbreak checks.
description:
Promptfoo is the cheapest way to make an LLM change look like an engineering change: a YAML file defines the prompts, the models, the test cases and the assertions, and the report tells you whether the swap you wanted is actually better. Because it is a CLI it drops into a pipeline, so a regression blocks a merge instead of appearing in a demo on Friday. The red-team mode automates prompt-injection and jailbreak probing across your targets.

Assertions are only as good as your test cases, so a green run over twenty hand-picked examples can still be a thin cover for real traffic. Open source and self-hostable, with a hosted layer if you want history and sharing — most teams use the CLI and never need the rest.
